rules.title: HRPC IDL keywords
rules.statement: The HRPC interface-definition language reserves the keyword tokens: `package`, `import`, `option`, `message`, `enum`, `service`, `rpc`, `returns`, `stream`, `repeated`, `optional`, `required`, `map`, `oneof`.
rules.uncertainty: HRPC is a separate IDL surface (RPC schema), not the Logos source language.

rules.title: HRPC punctuation tokens
rules.statement: HRPC punctuation tokens: `{` `}` `(` `)` `<` `>` `;` `=` `,` `.` (LBRACE RBRACE LPAREN RPAREN LANGLE RANGLE SEMICOLON EQUALS COMMA DOT).

rules.title: HRPC string literal
rules.statement: A STRING literal is a double-quoted sequence matching /"([^"\\]|\\.)*"/: any chars except quote/backslash, or a backslash escaping any single char, delimited by `"`.

rules.title: HRPC integer literal
rules.statement: An INTEGER literal is one or more decimal digits /[0-9]+/; no sign, base prefix, or separators.

rules.title: HRPC identifier
rules.statement: An IDENT matches /[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*/: leading ASCII letter or underscore, followed by ASCII letters, digits, or underscores.

rules.title: HRPC whitespace is insignificant
rules.statement: Whitespace /[ \t\n\r]+/ is skipped between tokens and is not significant.

rules.title: HRPC comments
rules.statement: HRPC supports line comments /\/\/[^\n]*/ (to end of line) and block comments /\/\*.*?\*\// (non-greedy, may span lines); both are skipped as trivia.
